title: Design System: Wedding Carnival (marketing site)
scope: Public marketing site only (redesign/site, published from docs/). Not the guest game app in apps/web.

display.purpose: One painted hero title per field, charcoal Shrikhand with the stepped shade.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the scene question.

title.purpose: Star billing line, show names, package names, scene name plates.

title-set.purpose: Ticket headings and the scene result line, in Mukta 800.

lede.purpose: Section ledes; weight 600 on painted fields.

label.purpose: Captions, slot labels, the credits block.

stamp.purpose: Stamped marks only; the only uppercase in the system.

shadows.name: painted-shade-yellow
shadows.purpose: text-shadow under charcoal Shrikhand on the pink field.

shadows.name: painted-shade-white
shadows.purpose: text-shadow under charcoal Shrikhand on the yellow field.

shadows.name: painted-shade-pink
shadows.purpose: text-shadow under charcoal Shrikhand on yellow when the field needs heat (closing, cover).

shadows.name: painted-on-dark
shadows.purpose: text-shadow under white Shrikhand section titles on charcoal.

shadows.name: painted-numeral
shadows.purpose: Small painted numerals on ticket stubs.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All state transitions and the stamp thump.

motion.name: bulb-chase
motion.purpose: Header bulb row only; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: stamp-thump
motion.value: 520ms ease 300ms both; from rotate(-12deg) scale(1.9) opacity 0 to rotate(-5deg) scale(1)
motion.purpose: Stamps land once on reveal; reduced motion shows them landed.

motion.name: glasses-drop
motion.purpose: Pixel sunglasses drop onto the right-answer portrait in the scene.

narrative.overview:
The site is a single-screen cinema's hoarding on a night street, and the couple's wedding is the picture it bills. A warm charcoal street surrounds flat, hand-painted fields of pink and yellow; titles are sign-painter lettering with a stepped painted shade; the stars are the bride and groom, billed at hoarding scale and cropped by the board's edge. Everything is flat paint: no gradients on surfaces, no photography, no glass.

The world is loud in colour and quiet in ornament. Exactly two repeatable units decorate it, the marquee bulb row and the ticket stub, and state is never carried by a hue change alone: it is stamped on. The visitor's own names re-letter the billing, so the hoarding is always about them.

Density is low and poster-like: one statement per field, ranked by field size, generous section rhythm on the charcoal between fields.
keyCharacteristics: Logo palette only: charcoal, pink, yellow, white, plus paper for tickets.
Shrikhand for painted titles, Mukta for everything read.
Two ornament units only: bulb row and ticket stub.
State is a stamped mark that thumps down once.
The visitor's names re-letter the surface live.
Every booking action is an email to info@weddingcarnival.live.

rules.name: The Logo Palette Rule
rules.body: The palette is the logo's charcoal, pink and yellow, with white and paper. No new hues, no tints of pink or yellow as surfaces, no gradients across a field.

rules.name: The Full-Ink-On-Pink Rule
rules.body: On the pink field, read copy is full charcoal. Soft Charcoal is for paper and yellow only (it falls under 4.5:1 on pink).

rules.name: The Painted Shade Rule
rules.body: Shrikhand titles are charcoal with a flat, stepped shade of 1px offsets down-right: 6 steps of yellow on pink, 5 of white on yellow, 6 of pink on yellow when the field needs heat. On charcoal the lettering turns white with 4 steps of pink. Small painted numerals take 2 steps. Never a blurred shadow, never a gradient fill.

rules.name: The Read-In-Mukta Rule
rules.body: Anything a visitor reads to understand (ledes, steps, features, captions, buttons, labels) is Mukta. Shrikhand is for what is billed, not explained.

rules.name: The Flat Paint Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no blur, no glass. The only offset is the hard stepped text shade on painted lettering, which is the sign painter's own device.

dos: Do letter every billed title in charcoal Shrikhand with the stepped shade matched to its field (yellow on pink, white or pink on yellow, white-with-pink on charcoal).
Do carry state with a stamp (Mukta 800 uppercase, 3px border, -5deg) that thumps once; hold it still under reduced motion.
Do draw ornament from the bulb row and the ticket stub only; keep frame bulbs whole with background-repeat: space.
Do use the charcoal pill with yellow text on pink and yellow fields, and the yellow pill on charcoal; point every booking action at info@weddingcarnival.live.
Do let the visitor's names re-letter the billing, the scene and the email subject.
Do caption every sample element (names, scene, crowd split, timings) as sample.
Do keep read copy full charcoal on pink.
donts: Don't add hues outside the logo palette, or gradients, blurs or box-shadows on any surface.
Don't introduce a third ornament unit, or emoji and font-glyph symbols in place of drawn marks.
Don't signal state by colour alone; a pink card without its stamp is not a right answer.
Don't set read copy in Shrikhand, or uppercase anything that isn't a stamp.
Don't add testimonials, press logos or claims the business can't back.
Don't loop motion loudly: the bulbs chase, the stamps land once, and that is all.
